verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a 'Filters & Rules' help article, cited by title only, and an 'Achieve inbox zero' marketing headline. Together they suggest mail can be routed into separate folders by hand, which approximates focused streams as a manual workaround rather than a built-in split inbox. Missing for 10: any documented split-inbox or automatic categorization (important/team/newsletters/calendar), evidence that filters can sort mail into priority streams, a priority-ordered triage view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
